apush-mcq-0143.reason: Read the full stimulus, then every rationale and every misconception. No debasement mention, no 'most lasting effect' ranking, no arms race, no rivals anywhere in the file. Option B's misconception now reads 'Silver paid for more war, not less: the passage has Spain raising taxes more than fivefold to pay for the largest army in Europe.' — each fact is in the stimulus (taxes raised more than fivefold, largest army in Europe, borrowed heavily, prices rose across Europe as more silver money circulated, wealth spent on soldiers and interest). Rationales A-D and all four general steps stay inside the stimulus; the 'Remember' line and general step 2 state general economic principles without attributing them to the passage. One minor observation, not a fail: option C's misconception says deficit spending 'contributed to the rise in prices' — the stimulus states borrowing continued and prices rose but does not explicitly tie borrowing to the price rise; the core refutation (borrowing continued) is directly supported.
